title: GPT-5 Mini and Nano take over familiar model IDs
summary:
GPT-5 Mini and Nano gained familiar model IDs, while a queue fix lets authenticated requests use their concurrency allowance.

`openai` was restored as GPT-5 Mini, while `openai-fast` switched to GPT-5 Nano. Both accept text and images and support tools. The update also set input and completion limits for the GPT-5 models and raised nectar-tier concurrency from 50 to 100 requests.

A per-IP queue bottleneck was fixed so its per-interval request limit matches the configured concurrency cap instead of allowing only one request to start. Text and image queue intervals were also adjusted.

Enter now forwards sign-in context with proxied text and image requests. API-key record defaults and authentication field handling were also updated.

highlights.title: GPT-5 Mini on `openai`
highlights.text: Use `openai` for GPT-5 Mini with text, image input, and tool support. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai).

highlights.title: GPT-5 Nano on `openai-fast`
highlights.text: Use `openai-fast` for GPT-5 Nano with text, image input, and tool support. It also has the `gpt-5-nano` alias. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).
